identityReviewRetry.reason: A generic raised curly crop and angular face replace the source low wave cap and softer long oval proportions.
identityReviewRetry.observedSource: Very short dark hair lies close to the skull in small waves with a low uneven fringe. The face is a long oval with fuller cheeks and rounded chin.
identityReviewRetry.observedResult: Raised loose ringlet-like front curls and a strong carved jaw/brow give the portrait a generic younger male fashion face.
identityReviewRetry.correction: Restore a close scalp-hugging dark brown short waved cap with very low volume and short sides. The low uneven front edge lies flat along the upper forehead, in small shallow waves, without raised ringlets, long curls or a quiff. Keep a moderately long oval face, softer full cheek planes, a restrained straight lower jaw and rounded chin. Maintain green eyes, moderate low-arched brows and very fine short stubble rather than a heavy beard. Preserve natural20-year-old proportions and avoid sculpted hollow cheeks or exaggerated jaw angles.
